[ASSISTANT_SAID] Differences between Cherry MX Brown and Cherry MX Speed switches include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry MX Brown: tactile and clicky, medium actuation force (55g), total travel distance 4mm, suitable for touch typists.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry MX Speed: linear and silent, light actuation force (45g), total travel distance 3.4mm, ideal for fast-paced games.
